fitted_on.score: DOPEST block B held-out test split (627 items)
fitted_on.note: yes/no answers inside (0.2, 0.8) are moved to the floor on their own side (JevBench abstention rule)

reasoning.note: second pass for unsure choice and score questions (serve.py --reason): the base model writes a two-sentence rationale ending in 'Answer:', the option letters (levels of a score) are read after it and mixed 50/50 with the one-pass distribution at temperature 3. Gates per type: choice below 0.75, score below 0.8, chosen on OpenDecisions (1178 choice, 588 score), the public JevBench items and the sealed-set replica so that the pooled extra cost stays within budget_usd_per_1000. max_seconds budgets the whole request (first readout included) on the serving GPU, min_new_tokens is the smallest rationale worth starting.
